expectations.buyer: Public-data product teams, civic-tech operators, researchers, and businesses dependent on government APIs
expectations.pain: Open government APIs and bulk datasets change schemas, endpoints, codes, cadence, or availability without a machine-readable consumer contract
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Official API changelogs and catalogues, OpenAPI/JSON Schema tooling, generic API monitors, data observability platforms, and manual adapters
expectations.biggestRisk: Generic API monitoring and public metadata may absorb the product while government providers have weak incentives to honor a third-party contract
